PAPERS.short: Pulczinski EPA controlled human exposure 3 consecutive days 35 ug/m3 PM2.5 FEV1 exercise 2026
PAPERS.title: Repeated Exposure to Near-Ambient PM(2.5) Decreases Pulmonary Function: Controlled Human Exposure Study.
PAPERS.pm: Concentrated ambient PM2.5 at 35 ug/m3, 4 h/day with intermittent exercise, 3 consecutive days vs clean air
PAPERS.endpoint: Spirometry (FEV1) at 0 and +20 h; exercise output
PAPERS.affil: US Environmental Protection Agency, USA; US Environmental Protection Agency, USA
PAPERS.n: First multi-day controlled human exposure: 17 healthy volunteers, 3 consecutive days at 35 ug/m3 PM2.5 (the US 24-h standard) vs clean air, crossover 2 weeks apart. Day 1 FEV1 unchanged (-0.9%, -2.1 to 0.3). Day 2 FEV1 -1.9% (-3.1 to -0.7) immediately and -1.7% (-3.3 to -0.2) at +20 h; Day 3 -1.8% (-3.5 to -0.1) and -1.7% (-3.2 to -0.1). Exercise output fell 2.0 W (Day 2) and 2.4 W (Day 3). n=17 healthy young adults, so sex-modification claims are underpowered, and the decrements are small against spirometric reproducibility. Relevance: direct - cumulative-day effects at a concentration low-cost networks routinely report argue for multi-day running means, not single-day exceedance flags.

PAPERS.short: He Beijing panel 152 young adults PNC5-560 gut microbiome pro-atherosclerotic biomarkers 2026
PAPERS.title: Exposure to Size-Fractioned Ambient Particles Associated with Alterations in Gut Microbiome and Pro-Atherosclerotic Biomarkers in Young Adults.
PAPERS.pm: Particle number concentration 5-560 nm from a fixed site, 7-day mean; PMF source split
PAPERS.endpoint: Circulating inflammatory/pro-atherosclerotic biomarkers; gut microbiome diversity
PAPERS.affil: Peking University, China; Peking University, China
PAPERS.n: Beijing panel of 152 young adults, four monthly visits (Sep 2019-Jan 2020). PNC 5-560 nm sources: diesel 37.9%, gasoline 39.4%, nucleation 9.2%, secondary 11.9%. Per IQR of 7-day PNC, inflammatory and pro-atherosclerotic biomarkers rose by 2.1% (0.4-3.8) to 198.6% (29.3-365.8); Shannon, Simpson and Chao1 diversity fell. Microbial mediation reached 9.8% (0.8-38.3) and 4.8% (0.09-22.5). The 2-to-199% span across many biomarkers signals heavy multiplicity, mediation shares are small with wide CIs, and a single fixed-site PNC stands in for personal number exposure. Relevance: indirect - number concentration, not mass, carries the signal, and mass-calibrated optical sensors cannot see most of the 5-560 nm range.

PAPERS.short: Mali Rutgers wildfire PM0.1 mouse ovarian hyperandrogenism AhR 2026
PAPERS.title: Wildfire-Emitted Particulate Matter Induces Ovarian Hyperandrogenism through Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Activation
PAPERS.pm: Lab-synthesised and June-2023 Canadian wildfire PM0.1, intratracheal instillation and in vitro
PAPERS.endpoint: Estrous cyclicity, serum testosterone, steroidogenic gene expression
PAPERS.affil: Rutgers University, USA; Rutgers University, USA
PAPERS.n: Mouse intratracheal exposure to lab-synthesised wildfire PM0.1 at a dose described as environmentally relevant disrupted estrous cycles and raised serum testosterone; follicles showed AhR activation and altered steroidogenic genes, reproduced by real Canadian 2023 wildfire PM0.1, BaP and TCDD, and reversed by AhR inhibition. Single-follicle and single-oocyte RNA-seq flagged inflammatory and mitochondrial genes. The abstract gives no dose in ug or lung-deposited equivalent, no group sizes and no effect magnitudes, so translation to human wildfire episodes cannot be judged. Relevance: indirect - the toxicity is attributed to the nanosized fraction, which optical sensors used for smoke alerts barely register.

PAPERS.short: Liu BALF fibroblast PM2.5 house dust mite FAM45A allergic asthma 2026
PAPERS.title: FAM45A-Mediated Persistent Memory-Like Fibroblast Reprogramming Drives PM2.5-Exacerbated Allergic Asthma.
PAPERS.design: Ex vivo primary cells + CRISPR + humanised mouse
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5 co-stimulation with house dust mite in vitro; residential PM2.5 exposure duration in a clinical cohort
PAPERS.endpoint: Antigen-presenting fibroblast phenotype; airway inflammation; asthma severity
PAPERS.affil: Characteristic Medical Center of Chinese People's Armed Police Force, China; Third People's Hospital of Shenzhen, China
PAPERS.n: BALF fibroblasts from 8 HDM-sensitised asthmatics and 8 sensitised non-asthmatic controls: only combined PM2.5 + HDM stimulation induced a persistent antigen-presenting, IL-33-secreting phenotype, with FAM45A the top dual-exposure transcript; FAM45A slows lysosomal allergen degradation via V-ATPase, is required by CRISPR knockout, and its neutralisation reduced PM2.5/HDM airway inflammation in humanised mice. In an expanded cohort fibroblast FAM45A correlated with residential PM2.5 exposure duration, HDM IgE and GINA severity. Primary-cell n=8 per group; PM2.5 dose and source are not given, and the clinical correlation is unquantified in the abstract. Relevance: indirect - an interaction mechanism that argues for allergen-season stratification of sensor-based asthma alerts.

PAPERS.short: Huang All of Us case-crossover wildfire smoke PM2.5 adult asthma exacerbation 2026
PAPERS.title: Asthma Exacerbations Following Wildfire Smoke PM2.5 Exposure Among U.S. Adults
PAPERS.pm: Wildfire-smoke PM2.5 at residence, lags 0-7 d, April-August 2006-2019
PAPERS.endpoint: Asthma exacerbation events (EHR)
PAPERS.n: NIH All of Us: 18,935 adult asthma exacerbations, four matched control periods each, warm months 2006-2019. Wildfire-smoke PM2.5 was associated with exacerbation at every lag 0-7 d, adjusted OR 1.27 (1.22-1.33) to 1.38 (1.32-1.44); higher in older adults, non-Hispanic White, Midwestern residents and in May. The abstract does not state the exposure increment or the smoke-PM product, so the OR cannot be scaled, and an OR near 1.3 is large for smoke PM per usual increments - likely a binary smoke-day or large contrast. All of Us EHR linkage selects insured, engaged participants. Relevance: indirect - the Midwestern excess points at long-range transported smoke, where PurpleAir density is thinnest.

PAPERS.short: Tsogtbayar Ulaanbaatar time-series PM1 PM2.5 under-5 pneumonia outpatient 2026
PAPERS.title: Associations between air pollution and pediatric pneumonia incidence in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia: age and sex susceptibility.
PAPERS.pm: Daily city PM1, PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NO2, O3 from monitors, per IQR
PAPERS.endpoint: Daily outpatient pneumonia visits, children <5 y
PAPERS.affil: Mongolian National University of Medical Sciences, Mongolia; Mongolian National University of Medical Sciences, Mongolia
PAPERS.n: Ulaanbaatar 2014-2019, 48,488 under-5 outpatient pneumonia visits, adjusted for season, weather, holidays and the raw-coal ban. At lag 2, per IQR: PM2.5 RR 1.057 (1.015-1.100), PM1 1.065 (1.025-1.106), SO2 1.136 (1.023-1.261), NO2 1.383 (1.108-1.726); PM10 and O3 non-significant. Infants <1 y showed PM1 RR 1.098 (1.046-1.152) at lag 0. PM2.5 and NO2 survived co-pollutant adjustment. IQR values are not in the abstract, outpatient visits depend on care-seeking, and NO2 dwarfs PM. Relevance: indirect - PM1 outperforming PM10 in a coal-heating city favours sub-micron-capable nodes in ger districts, where the regulatory monitors that fed this series are sparse.

PAPERS.short: Kulkayeva Almaty time-series PM2.5 cardiovascular mortality null 2026
PAPERS.title: Short-term effects of ambient PM2.5 exposure on cardiovascular mortality in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
PAPERS.pm: Daily city PM2.5, mean 36.9 +/- 33.3 ug/m3, lags 0-7 d
PAPERS.endpoint: Daily cardiovascular mortality
PAPERS.affil: Salidat Kairbekova National Scientific Research Center for Health Development, Kazakhstan; Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Kazakhstan
PAPERS.n: Almaty 2017-2025, 3,287 days, 43,095 cardiovascular deaths, mean PM2.5 36.9 ug/m3. Cumulative lag 0-7 RR 1.011 (0.837-1.222), null; age >=65 RR 1.174 (0.926-1.489), also null; lag-specific risk peaked at 2-4 days. The comparison increment for the cumulative RR is not given in the abstract, the CI spans a 16% deficit to a 22% excess, and the PM2.5 series source and station count are unstated. Relevance: indirect - Almaty's monitor record is thin and its PurpleAir network is one of the denser in Central Asia; a sensor-fused exposure series could narrow exactly this interval. Included as a reported null from an under-studied region.

PAPERS.short: Xu CHARLS PM1 PM2.5 PM10 cardiometabolic multimorbidity cohort 2026
PAPERS.title: EXPRESS: Air pollution increases cardiometabolic diseases in China: A nationwide longitudinal cohort study.
PAPERS.pm: Long-term PM1, PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2 (exposure model not stated in the abstract)
PAPERS.endpoint: Incident cardiometabolic multimorbidity
PAPERS.affil: First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University, China; First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University, China
PAPERS.n: CHARLS, 8,725 adults aged >=45 free of cardiometabolic multimorbidity (two or more of hypertension, diabetes, CVD, stroke) at 2011 baseline, followed to 2020. All five pollutants - PM1, PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2 - were associated with incident multimorbidity, more strongly with lower education and short sleep. The abstract reports no hazard ratios, increments, case counts or exposure model, so magnitude cannot be judged; participants with one condition at baseline were retained, which mixes progression with onset. Relevance: indirect - one more CHARLS reuse with a satellite-type exposure inferred; no new measurement contribution.

PAPERS.short: Lin prospective cohort plasma proteomics PM2.5 type 2 diabetes mediation 2026
PAPERS.title: Plasma Proteomic Profiling Reveals Mediating Proteins and Preventive Targets Linking Ambient Air Pollution to Type 2 Diabetes Incidence: A Prospective Cohort Study
PAPERS.pm: Long-term PM2.5, NO2, NOx, SO2 by bilinear interpolation of gridded estimates, per IQR
PAPERS.endpoint: Incident type 2 diabetes
PAPERS.affil: Sun Yat-sen University, China; Sun Yat-sen University, China
PAPERS.n: 44,917 participants with 2,911 plasma proteins, 13.64 years of follow-up, 3,193 incident T2D. Per IQR of PM2.5, NO2, NOx and SO2, T2D risk was 5-14% higher (pollutant-specific HRs not separated in the abstract). 187 proteins mediated the PM2.5-T2D association; a protein score mediated 31.69% for PM2.5. Hubs sat in cytokine, chemokine and leukocyte-migration pathways; 13 targets have approved drugs. The cohort is not named in the abstract. Proteins measured once, at baseline alongside the exposure window, make the mediation temporally ambiguous, and NO2, NOx and SO2 are correlated with PM2.5. Relevance: indirect - mechanism-oriented, with interpolated residential exposure and no new measurement contribution.

PAPERS.short: Tao Peking ART women 1-km PM2.5 follicular fluid metals 2026
PAPERS.title: Associations of ambient fine particulate matter exposure with metal and metalloid concentrations in follicular fluid.
PAPERS.pm: 12-month residential PM2.5 at 1-km resolution, per IQR
PAPERS.endpoint: 14 elements in follicular fluid
PAPERS.affil: Peking University, China; Peking University Third Hospital, China
PAPERS.n: 198 women undergoing assisted reproduction; 12-month residential PM2.5 at 1 km. Per IQR, follicular-fluid chromium +22.10% (9.59-36.04), lead +23.15% (1.27-49.76), cadmium +22.81% (8.95-38.44), arsenic +29.25% (8.13-54.49), germanium +15.72% (4.42-28.25), lithium +25.84% (9.65-44.43); five survived FDR, lead did not. The IQR value is not reported, n is small, diet and water - major Cd/As sources - are not mentioned as adjusted, and the PM2.5 surface has no composition, so the link to particle-borne metals is inferred. Relevance: indirect - a biomarker endpoint where metal-resolved sampling, not optical mass, would be needed to close the pathway.

PAPERS.short: Marques Generation R multi-cohort LUR PM2.5 NO2 epigenetic age birth to adolescence 2026
PAPERS.title: Outdoor Air pollution Exposure and Epigenetic Age from birth to adolescence - a multi-cohort study.
PAPERS.pm: Harmonised LUR NO2, NOx, PM10, PM2.5, black carbon at home address; pregnancy, recent and lifetime windows
PAPERS.endpoint: Epigenetic age (Bohlin, Horvath skin-and-blood clocks)
PAPERS.affil: Erasmus MC, Netherlands; Erasmus MC, Netherlands
PAPERS.n: European birth cohorts: 4,166 at birth, 1,531 at 4-7 y, 1,748 at 8-10 y, 2,546 at 16-18 y; harmonised LUR exposures in three windows, fixed-effects meta-analysis. No pollutant, PM2.5 included, was associated with epigenetic age at birth or in childhood. In adolescence, per 10 ug/m3 lifetime NO2, epigenetic age was 0.23 years higher (0.06-0.39), about 84 days, surviving adapted Bonferroni. PM associations were null in the main analysis. LUR at address omits school and transit time, which dominates adolescent exposure. Relevance: indirect - a well-powered PM null; the one signal is traffic NO2, not particle mass.

PAPERS.short: Zundel Detroit adolescents PM2.5 above 9 ug/m3 fear conditioning amygdala 2026
PAPERS.title: Outdoor Air Pollution Exposure Alters Fear Regulation and Fear-Related Neural Circuitry in Adolescence.
PAPERS.pm: Past-month PM2.5 from a spatiotemporal model, dichotomised at 9 ug/m3
PAPERS.endpoint: Skin conductance, subjective fear, amygdala/insula activation
PAPERS.affil: Wayne State University, USA; Wayne State University, USA
PAPERS.n: 102 adolescents aged 10-17 (68 with fMRI) completed Pavlovian conditioning, extinction and recall. Past-month PM2.5 above vs below 9 ug/m3: greater skin conductance and subjective fear to threat cues, greater return of fear at recall, higher overall SCR, and greater right amygdala (conditioning, extinction) and left insula (recall) activation, adjusted for age, sex and neighbourhood disadvantage. No effect sizes are given in the abstract. Dichotomising a modelled one-month mean at a regulatory cut-point in 102 people invites residual neighbourhood confounding. Relevance: indirect - short-window exposure contrasts like this need residence-level resolution that dense networks can supply.

PAPERS.short: Jeon rat PM2.5 inhalation sperm abnormality ACE2 vs renal insufficiency 2026
PAPERS.title: Particulate matter inhalation induces male reproductive dysfunction comparable to renal failure: insights from a rat model.
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5 at 30 mg/kg/day, 3 h/day for 10 days (route described as inhalation)
PAPERS.endpoint: Sperm count, motility, morphology; testicular ACE2 and inflammatory genes
PAPERS.affil: Korea University Ansan Hospital, South Korea; Korea University Ansan Hospital, South Korea
PAPERS.n: Male rats: control, PM2.5 (30 mg/kg/day, 3 h/day, 10 days) and renal insufficiency by unilateral ureteral obstruction. PM2.5 increased sperm morphological abnormalities; count and motility changes were not significant. Testicular ACE2 staining and inflammatory/endothelial gene expression shifted in both exposed and RI groups. Dose expressed per kg body weight for an inhalation exposure is unusual and cannot be converted to an air concentration; group sizes and effect magnitudes are absent, and the PM source is unstated. Relevance: minimal for sensing - mechanistic, at a dose far above ambient; logged for the reproductive-endpoint map.

PAPERS.short: Sternbach Beijing Clean Heating Policy difference-in-differences blood pressure 2026
PAPERS.title: China’s Clean Heating Policy and Effects on Blood Pressure in Rural Beijing Adults
PAPERS.pm: Policy-driven coal-to-clean heating transition (household air pollution and indoor temperature as pathways)
PAPERS.endpoint: Brachial and central systolic/diastolic blood pressure
PAPERS.affil: McGill University, Canada; McGill University, Canada
PAPERS.n: 1,003 adults >40 y in 50 rural Beijing villages enrolled before treatment; 20 villages switched from coal to electric or gas heating during follow-up. Two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences: brachial systolic -1.4 mmHg (-3.3 to 0.5), central systolic -1.5 (-3.3 to 0.4), brachial diastolic -1.6 (-2.9 to -0.3), central diastolic -1.6 (-2.9 to -0.3). Effects varied by treatment year, larger in early-treated villages. The exposure is policy assignment, not measured PM, and indoor temperature rises alongside; the abstract cannot separate the two pathways. Relevance: indirect - the clearest causal design in the household-energy literature; personal PM monitoring in the parent study is what would assign the mechanism.

PAPERS.short: Young CSU San Joaquin Valley agricultural community personal indoor PM2.5 PM10 2026
PAPERS.title: Particulate Matter Pollution in an Agricultural Setting: A Community-Engaged Research Study.
PAPERS.pm: 24-h gravimetric personal and indoor PM2.5 and PM10, three seasons
PAPERS.endpoint: Personal/indoor PM concentrations and determinants
PAPERS.affil: Colorado State University, USA; Colorado State University, USA
PAPERS.n: Community-engaged study, San Joaquin Valley: 35 Hispanic/Latino(a) participants from 18 households living a median 633 m from processing silos, sampled in December 2023, May 2024 and the September 2024 harvest. Median personal PM2.5 11.1 and PM10 45.5 ug/m3; indoor 12.9 and 24.3 ug/m3. 29% of PM2.5 and 33% of PM10 samples exceeded WHO 24-h guidelines. Agricultural work in the household and regional ambient PM were the strongest predictors. Small n, three visits, and no coarse-fraction composition to separate soil from processing dust. Relevance: direct - personal PM10 four times indoor PM10 shows a coarse take-home or activity component that ambient PM2.5 sensors miss entirely.

PAPERS.short: Mohsin California disaggregated AA NHPI wildfire-specific PM2.5 disparities 2026
PAPERS.title: Race disparities in total PM(2.5) and wildfire-specific PM(2.5) exposure among disaggregated Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander groups in California.
PAPERS.pm: Census-tract total and wildfire-specific PM2.5, 2008-2012, from EPA AQS-derived estimates
PAPERS.endpoint: Population-weighted PM2.5 by race group
PAPERS.affil: University of California Irvine, USA; University of California Irvine, USA
PAPERS.n: California census tracts, 2008-2012, total and wildfire-specific PM2.5 weighted by 2010 Census counts across five broad and 29 disaggregated AA and NHPI groups. Hmong populations had the highest average total and wildfire-specific PM2.5; Fijian, Laotian, Bhutanese, Marshallese and other Micronesian groups also ranked high for wildfire PM2.5. The abstract gives no concentrations or contrasts, the exposure period predates the 2017-2021 fire seasons, and the method for isolating wildfire PM2.5 from AQS data is unstated. Relevance: indirect - Central Valley Hmong communities are exactly where community sensor deployments could update a 15-year-old picture.

PAPERS.short: Wang Kwan Shenzhen 110,000 mobile signalling year-long temporal exposure averaging problem 2026
PAPERS.title: The temporal exposure averaging problem (TEAP).
PAPERS.pm: Mobility-weighted exposure to multiple air pollutants and greenspace from year-long mobile signalling
PAPERS.endpoint: Intra- and inter-individual deviation from annual exposure vs sampling length
PAPERS.affil: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), China; Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, China
PAPERS.n: Year-long mobile-signalling trajectories for 110,000 Shenzhen residents were combined with pollutant and greenspace surfaces; months were resampled to test how observation length shapes chronic-exposure estimates. Short windows produced large intra-individual deviations from annual exposure and inflated between-person variance; longer windows converged steadily, consistently across age, gender and indicators, and seasonally stratified vs random four-month samples agreed. No numerical deviation or convergence threshold is in the abstract, and the surfaces themselves carry model error that this framing does not address. Relevance: direct - a formal warning for wearable-sensor campaigns of days to weeks that report exposure inequality.

PAPERS.short: Li Nanjing jute cellulose filter PM2.5 sampling recovery oxidative potential 2026
PAPERS.title: An All-Natural Cellulose Fiber Filter Developed for High Recovery Sampling and In Vitro Toxicity Assessment of PM(2.5).
PAPERS.pm: Filter-collected PM2.5 for recovery, oxidative potential and cytotoxicity
PAPERS.endpoint: Filtration efficiency, pressure drop, recovery rate, OP, macrophage cytotoxicity
PAPERS.affil: Nanjing University, China; Nanjing University, China
PAPERS.n: Freeze-dried jute-pulp filter: filtration efficiency 81.55-99.41% across particle sizes at 216.8 Pa pressure drop; PM2.5 recovery 94.25-96.37%, higher than PTFE. Recovered PM2.5 showed higher oxidative potential and dose-dependent macrophage cytotoxicity than PTFE-recovered PM, and the filter degrades in soil. Higher OP from the new medium may mean better recovery or contamination by the cellulose itself; the abstract reports no blank OP or endotoxin control, and lower efficiency at the low end breaks mass closure. Relevance: indirect - relevant only if gravimetric co-location uses it; 81.55% minimum efficiency would bias reference mass low.

PAPERS.short: Khan Pakistan winter smog PM2.5-associated antimicrobial resistance genes qPCR 2026
PAPERS.title: PM2.5-Associated Variation in Airborne Antimicrobial Resistance Gene Abundance During Winter Smog Episodes in Urban Pakistan (2022–2023)
PAPERS.pm: Filter PM2.5 in Lahore, Islamabad, Okara, Nov-Dec 2022 and 2023; ARGs by qPCR
PAPERS.endpoint: Relative abundance of nine ARGs normalised to 16S rRNA
PAPERS.n: Winter PM2.5 sampled in three Pakistani cities; eDNA qPCR for sul1, blaTEM, blaCTX-M-32, blaNDM-1, vanA, vanRA, tnpA, intI1. Lahore PM2.5 reached 276.6 +/- 27.4 ug/m3 (AQI 289). blaNDM-1 had the highest relative abundance (0.077 Lahore, 0.056 Islamabad); vanA was higher in Okara. PM2.5 correlated with AQI (r=0.92) and humidity (r=0.91), which is near-tautological. No ARG-PM2.5 regression, sample count or blank controls are reported, so the PM link is spatial co-variation across three sites. Preprint. Relevance: minimal for sensing - a bioaerosol dimension that mass sensors cannot resolve, at concentrations where optical sensors also saturate.

PAPERS.short: Ubuane Lagos protocol paediatric asthma control household PM2.5 CO cotinine 2026
PAPERS.title: Association of asthma control with household particulate matter less than 2.5 microns, carbon monoxide and second-hand-smoking among children with asthma in Lagos, Nigeria: protocol of an ongoing observational cross-sectional study
PAPERS.pm: Objectively measured household PM2.5 and CO; urinary cotinine for second-hand smoke
PAPERS.endpoint: Asthma control (planned)
PAPERS.n: Protocol, no results. Children and adolescents up to 18 years attending LASUTH asthma clinics in Lagos are being recruited consecutively; asthma control, lung function (peak flow, FEV1, home PEF variability), adherence, inhaler technique, quality of life, urinary cotinine and household PM2.5 and CO will be related by hierarchical logistic regression. The rationale is that questionnaire-based household air pollution studies found no association. The PM2.5 instrument, sampling duration and sample size are not stated. Relevance: direct if it uses portable optical monitors - the protocol should specify instrument and calibration before data collection ends.

PAPERS.short: Bu Anmyeon-do GAW November 2025 Asian dust haze wildfire episodes aerosol optics 2026
PAPERS.title: Episode-Dependent Variations in Atmospheric Composition at the Anmyeon-Do Global Atmosphere Watch Station in November 2025
PAPERS.pm: PM10, scattering/absorption coefficients, Angstrom exponent, ion composition, reactive gases
PAPERS.endpoint: Episode-specific aerosol physical, optical and chemical properties
PAPERS.n: Anmyeon-do GAW station, November 2025: Asian dust, haze, high-PM and wildfire-influenced episodes vs non-event periods. PM10 in all events exceeded twice the non-event mean (24.8 +/- 9.9 ug/m3), peaking in Asian dust (66.1 +/- 19.2). Scattering Angstrom exponent was lowest in dust (1.1 +/- 0.5). Secondary ions made up 93.4% (haze) and 75.1% (high-PM) of measured composition; NOx was 1.5-1.7 times higher in haze/high-PM and CO rose most in the wildfire period. One month, one site, preprint. Relevance: direct - episode-dependent Angstrom and composition shifts are the conditions under which optical PM sensors' mass calibration breaks.

PAPERS.short: Yu Jeju Lunar New Year 2026 fireworks long-range transport K+ aerosol 2026
PAPERS.title: Fireworks-Influenced Aerosols on Jeju Island, Korea, During the 2026 Lunar New Year
PAPERS.pm: Filter PM2.5 and PM10, water-soluble ions, carbonaceous aerosol, size distributions
PAPERS.endpoint: K+-enriched episodes and transport attribution
PAPERS.n: Seogwipo, Jeju, 14-23 February 2026: two K+-enriched episodes with mean K+ 2.59 +/- 1.44 and 1.50 +/- 0.66 ug/m3, about 99% non-sea-salt. K+/total carbon was 5.5 and 3.9 times the pre-episode value, while absorption Angstrom exponents of 1.37 and 1.29 gave no optical sign of biomass burning; median transit from 120 E was 23 h, crossing on Lunar New Year's Day. Attribution to transported Chinese fireworks rests on K+ ratios and timing, not tracers such as Sr, Ba or Mg; PM2.5 mass is not reported in the abstract. Preprint. Relevance: indirect - a transported episode with fresh-composition particles.

PAPERS.short: Hauck USC plasma-enhanced electrostatic precipitator self-cleaning electrode diesel PM 2026
PAPERS.title: Plasma-Enhanced Electrostatic Precipitator (ESP) with Self-Cleaning Electrode for Scalable Remediation of Particulate Matter in Large Diesel Engines.
PAPERS.pm: Diesel exhaust particulate matter
PAPERS.endpoint: Removal efficiency, power penalty, regeneration durability
PAPERS.affil: University of Southern California, USA; University of Southern California, USA
PAPERS.n: Nanosecond-pulsed (20 kV, 20 ns) plasma-enhanced ESP, with ion densities about six orders above DC corona, removed >90% of diesel PM at 1% of engine power; a porous stainless-steel collector regenerated by Joule heating kept >89% removal over four cycles and >200 h. Target is megawatt-class marine and locomotive engines without acceptable after-treatment. Efficiency is mass-based in the abstract; size-resolved removal for ultrafine particles - the hardest for ESPs - and regeneration emissions are not given. Relevance: minimal for sensing - port and rail-yard networks would be the field test of whether such controls change fenceline PM.

PAPERS.short: Krevanko UW cannabis processing local exhaust ventilation inhalable PM terpenes 2026
PAPERS.title: Pilot study of a local exhaust ventilation system to control particle and terpene concentrations during cannabis processing.
PAPERS.pm: Inhalable PM and total terpenes with vs without LEV (MERV-13 + activated charcoal)
PAPERS.endpoint: Concentration reduction during grinding and pre-roll filling
PAPERS.affil: University of Washington, USA; University of Washington, USA
PAPERS.n: Partially enclosed local exhaust ventilation hood with MERV-13 particle and activated-charcoal terpene filters, tested in three paired trials during cannabis flower grinding and automated pre-roll filling. Inhalable PM fell on average 95% during grinding and 83% during pre-roll filling; terpenes fell below the limit of detection during grinding. Three paired trials, no absolute concentrations in the abstract, and area rather than personal sampling limit inference about worker dose. Relevance: indirect - inhalable organic dust is a coarse fraction that low-cost PM2.5 sensors under-report, so sensor-based workplace screening would miss the hazard this hood controls.

PAPERS.short: Laferriere VA burn pits registry headache phenotypes mixed methods 2026
PAPERS.title: Veteran deployed burn pits exposure: headache phenotypes, trajectories, and outcomes: a mixed-methods evaluation.
PAPERS.pm: Self-reported open burn pit smoke exposure (AH&OBP Registry)
PAPERS.endpoint: Headache phenotype, disability, insomnia, care trajectories
PAPERS.affil: VA Connecticut Healthcare System, USA; VA Connecticut Healthcare System, USA
PAPERS.n: Airborne Hazards and Open Burn Pit Registry: 247,583 linked participants; 1,980 surveyed, 772 responded (39.0%), 335 completed headache phenotyping, 49 interviewed. Migraine and post-traumatic headache carried more disability and insomnia than other headache; 68.0% of SDOH responders reported social isolation; many dated onset to deployment. There is no unexposed comparator, burn-pit exposure is self-reported, and 335 of 247,583 is a highly selected fraction. No PM metric is measured, and headache is not compared with other registry outcomes. Relevance: indirect - deployment smoke exposure remains unquantified, a gap personal samplers in future deployments could close.

PAPERS.short: Suter LDSA lung-deposited surface area summer measurements spatiotemporal modelling 2026
PAPERS.title: Measurements and exploratory spatiotemporal modelling of LDSA in summer
PAPERS.design: Metadata only: no abstract in Crossref at issue time
PAPERS.pm: Lung-deposited surface area (LDSA)
PAPERS.endpoint: Not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only; no abstract in Crossref at issue time, so no finding is asserted. The title describes summer measurements of lung-deposited surface area and an exploratory spatiotemporal model of it. LDSA is the dose-relevant ultrafine metric that diffusion-charger sensors report and optical sensors cannot; a spatiotemporal surface would let health studies use it at scale. To be assessed when the Elsevier abstract deposits: instrument (diffusion charger model), number of sites or mobile route, model predictors and cross-validated skill. Relevance: possible, likely direct - LDSA surfaces would be the natural target for diffusion-charger networks.

PAPERS.short: Li Wuhan impervious surface morphology land surface temperature PM2.5 2015-2024 2026
PAPERS.title: Combined effects of impervious surface morphology on land surface temperature and PM2.5 pollution: Evidence from long-term observations (2015–2024) in Wuhan, China
PAPERS.design: Metadata only: no abstract in Crossref at issue time
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5 (observation source not available)
PAPERS.endpoint: Not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only; no abstract in Crossref at issue time, so no finding is asserted. The title promises a decade (2015-2024) of observations in Wuhan relating impervious-surface morphology to both land surface temperature and PM2.5. Carried because urban-form predictors are standard LUR inputs and a joint heat-PM treatment matters for co-exposure studies, since heat and PM2.5 share urban-form drivers and confound each other in health models. To be assessed when the abstract deposits: whether PM2.5 comes from monitors or satellite retrievals, spatial unit, and whether morphology effects survive meteorological adjustment and wind. Relevance: possible, unassessed; a candidate LUR-predictor source.

PAPERS.short: Shao greening Chinese cities air pollution deaths 25-year scenario health impact 2026
PAPERS.title: Greening Chinese cities could prevent air pollution—related deaths: A 25-year analysis and scenario-based health impact assessment
PAPERS.design: Metadata only: no abstract in Crossref at issue time
PAPERS.pm: Air pollution (pollutant set not available)
PAPERS.endpoint: Not recoverable
PAPERS.n: Metadata only; no abstract in Crossref at issue time, so no finding is asserted. The title describes a 25-year analysis of urban greening in Chinese cities and scenario-based estimates of air-pollution-related deaths avoidable by further greening. Read against the 6 November Korean urban-forest isotope study, which found vegetation lowered PM2.5 only in the growing season. To be assessed when the abstract deposits: pollutant(s), the greening-to-concentration function and whether it is causal or cross-sectional, and the concentration-response function used, since greening scenarios usually borrow risk functions rather than observe deaths. Relevance: possible, unassessed.
